model: CommStat 4 lead/lag controller via Modbus Interface Adapter
applies_to: Marvair CommStat 4 controllers with protocol version 3 or later and software revision 67 or later, read through the Marvair Modbus Interface Adapter.
summary: The CommStat 4 is a Marvair HVAC controller for equipment shelters; a master controller and an optional slave controller each run two HVAC units in lead/lag. A separate Marvair adapter plugs into a CommStat 4 master communications port and acts as a Modbus TCP and Modbus RTU slave. The map gives the controller settings, inputs, unit outputs, lockouts and stage, plus a second register block used to push new settings.

addressing.note: Registers are printed as 40001-40068 (read) and 40101-40143 (write), Modicon holding-register style. Request 40001 as wire address 0 and 40101 as wire address 100.

source.title: CommStat 4 Modbus Interface Adapter Installation and Operation Manual
source.pages: read registers pp. 9-10, bit notes pp. 11-12, write registers and write procedure pp. 13-14, serial settings p. 15

notes: All values are single registers. The bit notes only define bits 0-7.

The adapter guide gives no units or scaling for the set points and differentials; it only says to see the CommStat 4 manual. They are listed here as raw values. Only the slave sensor readings 40063-40065 are labelled °F.
Registers 40051-40054 (saved output values) are marked internal use and are left out.

Write procedure: write 1 to 40101 so the adapter stops refreshing the new-value block, write the new values to 40102-40143, then write 2 to 40101. The adapter shows 3 while waiting and returns to 0 when the CommStat 4 has taken the values.
The guide does not list the function-code values for 40143 or the value meanings of settings #10 and #16.
The guide states a default Modbus RTU setting of 9600 N 8 1 but no RTU slave address.
The guide does not name the read function code; by the usual Modicon convention, 4xxxx numbers are holding registers (function 03).

integration.summary: Poll 40001-40068 over TCP port 502 (or RTU 9600 8N1): 40057 temperature, 40056 stage, 40055/40068 lockouts, 40044 alarms and 40047/40048 unit outputs. Change settings only through the 40101 handshake.
integration.enable: Install the Marvair Modbus Interface Adapter and plug its RJ11 cable into one of the master communication ports on the CommStat 4 board. Set the adapter IP through its web page.
quirks: Writes go to a separate block (40101 up) and only take effect after the 40101 handshake.
Current temperature 240 means sensor fault; slave sensor value 0 means sensor fault.
setup: Default IP 192.168.1.19 (static); browse to it to set DHCP or a new static address, then the adapter reboots in about 60 s.
A reset button on the adapter board restores the default IP.
The adapter needs 24-60 V DC and must be mounted inside the shelter.
gotchas: Only CommStat 4 protocol version 3+ with software revision 67+ is supported.
In a two-controller shelter one master port may already carry the master/slave link.
